lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four identifiable vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin attachment area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a visible grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal feature running longitudinally across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a distinct luminance gradient with light pixels on the dorsal edge and darker pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion of the ventral and anterior-lateral surfaces by a high-density school of small, silver-colored fish exhibiting high specular reflectance.
